cases.task_line: - [ ] In `xmeasure/mappers/timeparse.py`: implement `parse_github_time(s: str) -> datetime` — `datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z', '+00:00')).astimezone(UTC)` with UTC from xmeasure.constants. Every datetime is timezone-aware UTC. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_timeparse.py::test_github_time_is_utc" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/mappers/timeparse.py`: implement `parse_jira_time(s: str) -> datetime` — Jira format "2026-09-01T10:15:30.000-0400": `datetime.strptime(s, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z').astimezone(UTC)`. Every datetime is timezone-aware UTC. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_timeparse.py::test_jira_time_converts_offset_to_utc" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/mappers/timeparse.py`: implement `parse_date(s: str) -> datetime` — "YYYY-MM-DD" → midnight UTC that day (`datetime.strptime(s, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(tzinfo=UTC)`). — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_timeparse.py::test_parse_date_is_midnight_utc" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/store/codec.py`: implement the ISO codec pair `to_iso(t: datetime | None) -> str | None` (`t.isoformat()`) and `from_iso(s: str | None) -> datetime | None` (`datetime.fromisoformat(s)`); None passes through both. The offset in the ISO text keeps the result UTC-aware. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_codec.py::test_iso_round_trip_keeps_utc" "tests/unit/test_codec.py::test_none_passes_through" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/metrics/result.py`: implement `make_result(metric_id: str, window: Window, value: float | None, n: int, detail: dict[str, float | int | None] | None = None) -> MetricResult` — unit from `METRICS_BY_ID[metric_id]['unit']`; `window_label=window.label`; round `value` and every FLOAT in detail with `round(x, 3)` (ints untouched); if `n < MIN_SAMPLE` return value=None and note=NOTE_INSUFFICIENT but keep n and detail; else note ''. Construct dataclasses with keyword arguments only. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_result.py::test_make_result_fills_unit_and_label" "tests/unit/test_result.py::test_small_sample_hides_value_but_keeps_n_and_detail" "tests/unit/test_result.py::test_values_and_detail_are_rounded_to_3_decimals" passes

Every datetime is timezone-aware UTC. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_timeparse.py::test_github_time_is_utc" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/mappers/timeparse.py`: implement `week_start(t: datetime) -> datetime` — Monday 00:00 UTC of t's ISO week (midnight of t's date minus t.weekday() days). — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_timeparse.py::test_week_start_is_monday_midnight_utc" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/store/codec.py`: implement the JSON list pair `to_json_list(items: tuple[str, ...]) -> str` (`json.dumps(list(items))`) and `from_json_list(s: str) -> tuple[str, ...]` (a TUPLE, not a list). — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_codec.py::test_json_list_round_trip" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/metrics/result.py`: implement `no_source(metric_id: str, window: Window) -> MetricResult` — value None, n 0, note NOTE_NO_SOURCE, unit from METRICS_BY_ID, detail {}. Construct dataclasses with keyword arguments only. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_result.py::test_no_source" "tests/conformance/test_p1_foundation.py" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/config/windows.py`: implement `parse_windows(raw: dict) -> tuple[Window, Window | None]` — raw is the YAML `windows` mapping; baseline required, pilot optional; each needs `start` and `end` as YYYY-MM-DD strings (use xmeasure.mappers.timeparse.parse_date), start < end, labels 'baseline' / 'pilot'; the pilot must not overlap the baseline. Raise xmeasure.errors.ConfigError whose message STARTS WITH `windows.baseline` or `windows.pilot`. Window(label=..., start=..., end=...) keyword-only. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_config_windows.py" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/config/github.py`: implement `parse_github(raw: dict | None) -> GithubConfig | None` — None → None; defaults api_url 'https://api.github.com' (rstrip '/'), token_env 'GITHUB_TOKEN'; deploy_workflows and ai_labels become TUPLES. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_config_sections.py::test_github_defaults_and_tuples" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/config/xanadu.py`: implement `parse_xanadu(raw: dict | None, base_dir: Path) -> XanaduConfig | None` — None → None; log_paths resolved like repo paths, as a tuple of Path. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_config_sections.py::test_xanadu_paths_resolve" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/mappers/ai_attribution.py`: implement `commit_is_ai(subject: str, body: str, author_email: str, ai_author_emails: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool` — true if `re.search(AI_TRAILER_PATTERN, body)` (from xmeasure.constants; it is already MULTILINE + case-insensitive), or `re.match(XANADU_TASK_SUBJECT_PATTERN, subject)`, or author_email in ai_author_emails. A mention of 'Claude' outside a Co-Authored-By trailer is NOT AI. Pure function: no I/O, no network, no datetime.now(), no environment variables. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_ai_attribution.py::test_commit_trailer_task_subject_and_email" passes

Pure function: no I/O, no network, no datetime.now(), no environment variables. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_m_first_review.py" passes

ConfigError messages start with `repos`. RepoConfig(path=..., github=...) keyword-only. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_config_repos.py" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/config/top_level.py`: define `TOP_LEVEL_KEYS` (frozenset of: team store windows repos github jira xanadu ai exclude_authors test_globs survey) and implement `check_top_level(raw: dict) -> None` — the first unknown key (sorted) raises ConfigError whose message starts with that key; missing/empty team or store raises ConfigError starting with `team` / `store`. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_config_top_level.py" passes

- [ ] In `xmeasure/metrics/cycle_time.py`: implement `cycle_time(prs: tuple[PullRequest, ...], reviews: tuple[Review, ...], window: Window) -> MetricResult` — over PRs merged in the window: start = first_commit_at or created_at; hours = (merged_at - start).total_seconds()/3600; value = stats.median(hours); detail: p85 = stats.percentile(hours, 85), coding = median(created_at - start), review_wait = median(first review - created_at), review_to_merge = median(merged_at - first review) using first_review_times keyed by (pr.repo, pr.number); PRs without a review are left out of the two review medians only. n = merged PRs. Build the result with xmeasure.metrics.result.make_result (never MetricResult(...) directly); make_result applies MIN_SAMPLE and rounding. Pure function: no I/O, no network, no datetime.now(), no environment variables. — done when: its tests pass; task gate: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "tests/unit/test_m_cycle_time.py" passes
